comment: MCP servers WinBrow bridges into its tool registry.
Each entry: id (unique slug), 'command' for stdio servers,
Add a server = one JSON block. Nothing else to change.
'preload': connect at agent startup (RAM discipline on 2-core/5.9GB);
others connect lazily on first use / cache bootstrap.
'tier' may only LOWER to t0/t1 for verified read-only catalogs;
writes/system verbs stay T2/T3 via the normal policy classifier.
mcp-search-server (PyPI: missing) is covered in parts: wikipedia+fetch
Node servers MUST run as [cmd, /c, npx, ...]: npx.ps1 is execution-
policy blocked and Popen will not resolve .cmd itself. All lazy.
filesystem is sandboxed to the user profile (%USERPROFILE% via cmd);
git defaults to this repo (pass repo_path for others).

servers.description: Wikipedia search/articles/summaries/sections/links/related/key-facts — 9 tools x2 aliases (PyPI, MIT, no key)
Official reference URL fetcher — any URL to clean markdown (no key)
arXiv research paper search + download/read papers (PyPI, no key)
Crossref DOI/academic metadata: works, journals, publishers (PyPI, no key)
Remote weather MCP over streamable HTTP (no key by design)
WinBrow bundled: definitions/synonyms/phonetics via dictionaryapi.dev
WinBrow bundled: book/ISBN/author lookup via Open Library
WinBrow bundled: OpenStreetMap geocoding (place -> lat/lon)
WinBrow bundled: country data via restcountries.com
WinBrow bundled: ECB FX rates + currency conversion via frankfurter.dev
WinBrow bundled: USGS earthquake catalog (recent significant events)
WinBrow bundled: HN front page + story search (Algolia, no key)
WinBrow bundled: PUBLIC GitHub repo search (~60 req/hr unauth)
WinBrow bundled: MDN Web Docs search (HTML/CSS/JS/API references)
WinBrow bundled: global news search via GDELT 2.0 DOC API
WinBrow bundled: Reddit post search via public JSON
Official filesystem server: read/write/edit/move/create files+dirs, list, tree, glob search, metadata — sandboxed to the user profile (verified live, 14 tools)
Official git server: status/diffs/log/branches for this repo by default, other repos via repo_path arg (verified live, 12 tools)
Official time server: current time in any IANA timezone + cross-timezone conversion (verified live, read-only)
Official memory server: persistent knowledge graph (entities/relations/observations) in tools/memory_graph.json (verified live, 9 tools)
Official sequential-thinking server: structured step-by-step dynamic thought replanning during complex chains (verified live, 1 tool)
WinBrow bundled: LOCAL PDF reading via pypdf — extract_text (page ranges), info (pages/TOC/metadata), search (page+snippet) (verified live, 3 tools)
